summary: Catarman National Airport (CRM) is the principal air gateway to Northern Samar province in the Eastern Visayas region of the Philippines. Situated near the provincial capital of Catarman, it connects this remote island area to Manila and other domestic hubs, supporting tourism, government travel, and local commerce. The airport features a single runway and a modest terminal typical of Philippine regional airports.
faqs:
Q: What destinations can I fly to from Catarman National Airport?
A: The airport primarily serves flights to Manila, operated by domestic carriers connecting Northern Samar to the Philippine capital.

Q: How far is the airport from Catarman town center?
A: The airport is located just a few kilometers from the town proper, making it a quick ride by tricycle or jeepney.

Q: What facilities are available at the terminal?
A: As a smaller regional airport, it offers basic amenities including a terminal building, waiting areas, and ground transportation services.

Q: When is the best time to fly to Catarman?
A: The dry season
